```{r helpers, include=FALSE}
is_abs_path <- function(p) {
  p <- as.character(p)
  if (is.na(p) || !nzchar(p)) return(FALSE)
  grepl("^(/|[A-Za-z]:[\\/])", p)
}

find_git_root <- function(start = getwd(), max_up = 10) {
  p <- normalizePath(start, winslash = "/", mustWork = FALSE)
  for (i in 0:max_up) {
    if (dir.exists(file.path(p, ".git"))) return(p)
    up <- normalizePath(file.path(p, ".."), winslash = "/", mustWork = FALSE)
    if (identical(up, p)) break
    p <- up
  }
  ws <- Sys.getenv("GITHUB_WORKSPACE", unset = "")
  if (nzchar(ws) && dir.exists(ws)) return(normalizePath(ws, winslash = "/", mustWork = FALSE))
  normalizePath(getwd(), winslash = "/", mustWork = FALSE)
}

git_root <- find_git_root()

resolve_from_root <- function(p) {
  p <- as.character(p)
  if (is.na(p) || !nzchar(p) || p %in% c("NA","NULL")) return(NA_character_)
  if (is_abs_path(p)) return(p)
  file.path(git_root, p)
}

parse_time <- function(x) {
  # Names are written by the runner script as "YYYY-mm-dd HH:MM:SS"
  strptime(x, "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S", tz = "UTC")
}

to_wgs84 <- function(x) {
  if (is.null(crs(x))) return(x)
  out <- try(terra::project(x, "EPSG:4326"), silent = TRUE)
  if (inherits(out, "try-error")) x else out
}

safe_range <- function(r) {
  vv <- try(terra::values(r, mat = FALSE), silent = TRUE)
  if (inherits(vv, "try-error")) return(c(0, 1))
  vv <- vv[is.finite(vv)]
  if (length(vv) == 0) return(c(0, 1))
  range(vv)
}

pal_fun <- function(r) leaflet::colorNumeric("viridis", domain = safe_range(r), na.color = "transparent")

legend_html <- function(id, title, pal, breaks, suffix = "", show = TRUE) {
  # breaks: numeric vector length >= 2
  mids <- (breaks[-1] + breaks[-length(breaks)]) / 2
  cols <- pal(mids)
  labs <- paste0(format(breaks[-length(breaks)], trim = TRUE), "–",
                 format(breaks[-1], trim = TRUE), suffix)
  items <- paste0(
    "<div class='item'><i style='background:", cols, "'></i><span>", labs, "</span></div>",
    collapse = ""
  )
  disp <- if (show) "" else "display:none;"
  paste0(
    "<div id='", id, "' class='maplegend' style='", disp, "'>",
    "<div class='title'>", title, "</div>",
    items,
    "</div>"
  )
}

# Robust NetCDF loader
load_nc_var <- function(nc_path, var) {
  if (is.na(nc_path) || !file.exists(nc_path)) return(NULL)

  r1 <- try(terra::rast(nc_path, subds = var), silent = TRUE)
  if (!inherits(r1, "try-error")) return(r1)

  r2 <- try(terra::rast(paste0("NETCDF:", nc_path, ":", var)), silent = TRUE)
  if (!inherits(r2, "try-error")) return(r2)

  s <- try(terra::sds(nc_path), silent = TRUE)
  if (!inherits(s, "try-error")) {
    nms <- names(s)
    ii <- which(tolower(nms) == tolower(var) | grepl(var, nms, ignore.case = TRUE))
    if (length(ii) > 0) {
      r3 <- try(terra::rast(s[[ii[1]]]), silent = TRUE)
      if (!inherits(r3, "try-error")) return(r3)
    }
  }

  NULL
}

# Peak hour raster from a multi-layer raster and vector of forecast hours per layer
peak_hour_raster <- function(x, hours_vec) {
  if (nlyr(x) == 1) {
    out <- x
    values(out) <- 0
    return(out)
  }
  arg <- terra::app(x, fun = which.max, na.rm = TRUE)
  terra::subst(arg, from = seq_along(hours_vec), to = hours_vec)
}

# Aggregate max value and peak-hour maps from one storm, using only forecast-time layers
storm_products <- function(row, fc0) {
  hs0 <- load_nc_var(row$haz_nc, "Hs0")
  pr  <- load_nc_var(row$haz_nc, "Pr")
  if (is.null(hs0) || is.null(pr)) return(NULL)

  t_all <- parse_time(names(hs0))
  if (all(is.na(t_all))) {
    # fallback: assume regular 3-hourly from 0
    hours_all <- seq(0, by = 3, length.out = nlyr(hs0))
    keep <- rep(TRUE, nlyr(hs0))
  } else {
    keep <- t_all >= fc0
    if (!any(keep, na.rm = TRUE)) keep <- rep(TRUE, length(t_all))
    t_sel <- t_all[keep]
    hours_all <- as.numeric(difftime(t_sel, fc0, units = "hours"))
    hours_all[!is.finite(hours_all)] <- 0
  }

  hs0_f <- hs0[[which(keep)]]
  pr_f  <- pr[[which(keep)]]

  # Inverse barometer surge (m): (1010 - Pr)/100
  ibs_f <- (1010 - pr_f) / 100

  hs0_max <- terra::app(hs0_f, max, na.rm = TRUE)
  ibs_max <- terra::app(ibs_f, max, na.rm = TRUE)

  hs0_tpk <- peak_hour_raster(hs0_f, hours_all)
  ibs_tpk <- peak_hour_raster(ibs_f, hours_all)

  list(
    hs0_max = hs0_max, hs0_tpk = hs0_tpk,
    ibs_max = ibs_max, ibs_tpk = ibs_tpk
  )
}

# Update "best" rasters by taking the storm with larger max at each cell
update_best <- function(best_val, best_t, new_val, new_t) {
  # align
  new_val <- terra::resample(new_val, best_val, method = "bilinear")
  new_t   <- terra::resample(new_t,   best_t,   method = "near")

  cond <- !is.na(new_val) & (is.na(best_val) | (new_val > best_val))
  best_val <- terra::ifel(cond, new_val, best_val)
  best_t   <- terra::ifel(cond, new_t,   best_t)
  list(best_val = best_val, best_t = best_t)
}
```

```{r load-index}
outdir <- params$outdir
idx_file <- file.path(git_root, outdir, "index.csv")

if (!file.exists(idx_file)) {
  cat("<h2>No outputs yet</h2>\n")
  cat("<p><code>", idx_file, "</code> not found. Run the workflow (or wait for the next schedule) and refresh.</p>\n", sep="")
  knitr::knit_exit()
}

idx <- read.csv(idx_file, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
idx <- idx[idx$status == "ok", , drop = FALSE]
idx <- head(idx, params$max_storms)

if (nrow(idx) == 0) {
  cat("<h2>No successful storms in index</h2>\n")
  cat("<p>The workflow ran, but did not produce any successful storm outputs.</p>\n")
  knitr::knit_exit()
}

# Resolve paths
path_cols <- intersect(c("gpkg","haz_nc"), names(idx))
for (cc in path_cols) {
  idx[[cc]] <- as.character(idx[[cc]])
  idx[[cc]] <- vapply(idx[[cc]], resolve_from_root, character(1))
}

idx
```

```{r build-products}
# First pass: load all TC tracks (for plotting) and get forecast start times + union extent
tc_all <- list()
exts <- list()
fc0_vec <- rep(NA, nrow(idx))

for (i in seq_len(nrow(idx))) {
  if (is.na(idx$gpkg[i]) || !file.exists(idx$gpkg[i])) next
  TC <- terra::vect(idx$gpkg[i])
  TC_ll <- to_wgs84(TC)

  # Forecast start time from the first forecast segment (if present)
  fc_times <- TC_ll$ISO_TIME[TC_ll$DATASET == "forecast"]
  fc_times <- fc_times[!is.na(fc_times) & nzchar(fc_times)]
  if (length(fc_times) > 0) {
    fc0_vec[i] <- parse_time(fc_times[1])
  } else {
    # fallback: first time in file
    all_times <- TC_ll$ISO_TIME[!is.na(TC_ll$ISO_TIME) & nzchar(TC_ll$ISO_TIME)]
    fc0_vec[i] <- if (length(all_times) > 0) parse_time(all_times[1]) else Sys.time()
  }

  tc_all[[i]] <- TC_ll
  exts[[i]] <- terra::ext(TC_ll)
}

# Union extent (fallback to global tropics-ish if empty)
if (length(exts) == 0) {
  e_union <- terra::ext(80, 200, -60, 40)
} else {
  e_union <- exts[[1]]
  if (length(exts) > 1) {
    for (j in 2:length(exts)) e_union <- terra::union(e_union, exts[[j]])
  }
}

# Template grid for combining storms
template <- terra::rast(ext = e_union, res = params$res_deg, crs = "EPSG:4326")
best_hs0 <- terra::init(template, NA)
best_hs0_t <- terra::init(template, NA)
best_ibs <- terra::init(template, NA)
best_ibs_t <- terra::init(template, NA)

# Combine all storms cell-wise
for (i in seq_len(nrow(idx))) {
  row <- idx[i, , drop = FALSE]
  if (is.na(row$haz_nc) || !file.exists(row$haz_nc)) next
  fc0 <- fc0_vec[i]
  if (is.na(fc0)) fc0 <- Sys.time()

  prod <- try(storm_products(row, fc0), silent = TRUE)
  if (inherits(prod, "try-error") || is.null(prod)) next

  # Project to EPSG:4326 and resample onto template
  hs0_max_ll <- to_wgs84(prod$hs0_max)
  hs0_tpk_ll <- to_wgs84(prod$hs0_tpk)
  ibs_max_ll <- to_wgs84(prod$ibs_max)
  ibs_tpk_ll <- to_wgs84(prod$ibs_tpk)

  # Update best for Hs0
  up1 <- update_best(best_hs0, best_hs0_t, hs0_max_ll, hs0_tpk_ll)
  best_hs0 <- up1$best_val
  best_hs0_t <- up1$best_t

  # Update best for IB surge
  up2 <- update_best(best_ibs, best_ibs_t, ibs_max_ll, ibs_tpk_ll)
  best_ibs <- up2$best_val
  best_ibs_t <- up2$best_t
}

# Tracks combined for plotting
TC_all <- if (length(tc_all) > 0) do.call(rbind, tc_all) else NULL
```

```{r build-maps}
# Palettes + legends
pal_hs0 <- pal_fun(best_hs0)
pal_ibs <- pal_fun(best_ibs)
pal_hs0_t <- pal_fun(best_hs0_t)
pal_ibs_t <- pal_fun(best_ibs_t)

br_hs0 <- pretty(safe_range(best_hs0), n = 6)
br_ibs <- pretty(safe_range(best_ibs), n = 6)
br_hs0_t <- pretty(safe_range(best_hs0_t), n = 6)
br_ibs_t <- pretty(safe_range(best_ibs_t), n = 6)

leg_max_hs0 <- legend_html("legend-max-hs0", "Max Hs0 (m)", pal_hs0, br_hs0, suffix = " m", show = TRUE)
leg_max_ibs <- legend_html("legend-max-ibs", "Max IB surge (m)", pal_ibs, br_ibs, suffix = " m", show = FALSE)

leg_t_hs0 <- legend_html("legend-time-hs0", "Hs0 peak time (forecast hr)", pal_hs0_t, br_hs0_t, suffix = " h", show = TRUE)
leg_t_ibs <- legend_html("legend-time-ibs", "IB surge peak time (forecast hr)", pal_ibs_t, br_ibs_t, suffix = " h", show = FALSE)

# Bounds for fit
bb <- as.vector(terra::ext(template))  # xmin xmax ymin ymax

base_tiles <- leaflet::providers$CartoDB.Positron

m_max <- leaflet(height = 700) |>
  addProviderTiles(base_tiles) |>
  fitBounds(bb[1], bb[3], bb[2], bb[4])

if (!is.null(TC_all)) {
  m_max <- m_max |>
    addPolylines(data = TC_all[TC_all$DATASET == "track", ], weight = 2, opacity = 0.9, group = "Observed track") |>
    addPolylines(data = TC_all[TC_all$DATASET == "forecast", ], weight = 2, opacity = 0.8, dashArray = "6,6", group = "Forecast track")
}

m_max <- m_max |>
  addRasterImage(best_hs0, colors = pal_hs0, opacity = 0.7, group = "Max Hs0 (m)") |>
  addRasterImage(best_ibs, colors = pal_ibs, opacity = 0.7, group = "Max IB surge (m)") |>
  addLayersControl(
    baseGroups = c("Max Hs0 (m)", "Max IB surge (m)"),
    overlayGroups = c("Observed track", "Forecast track"),
    options = layersControlOptions(collapsed = FALSE)
  ) |>
  hideGroup("Max IB surge (m)") |>
  addControl(leg_max_hs0, position = "bottomright") |>
  addControl(leg_max_ibs, position = "bottomright")

m_max <- htmlwidgets::onRender(m_max, "
function(el, x) {
  var map = this;
  function showLegend(name){
    var hs0 = document.getElementById('legend-max-hs0');
    var ibs = document.getElementById('legend-max-ibs');
    if (!hs0 || !ibs) return;
    if (name === 'Max IB surge (m)') { hs0.style.display='none'; ibs.style.display='block'; }
    else { hs0.style.display='block'; ibs.style.display='none'; }
  }
  map.on('baselayerchange', function(e){ showLegend(e.name); });
  // initial
  showLegend('Max Hs0 (m)');
}
")

m_time <- leaflet(height = 700) |>
  addProviderTiles(base_tiles) |>
  fitBounds(bb[1], bb[3], bb[2], bb[4])

if (!is.null(TC_all)) {
  m_time <- m_time |>
    addPolylines(data = TC_all[TC_all$DATASET == "track", ], weight = 2, opacity = 0.9, group = "Observed track") |>
    addPolylines(data = TC_all[TC_all$DATASET == "forecast", ], weight = 2, opacity = 0.8, dashArray = "6,6", group = "Forecast track")
}

m_time <- m_time |>
  addRasterImage(best_hs0_t, colors = pal_hs0_t, opacity = 0.7, group = "Hs0 peak time (forecast hr)") |>
  addRasterImage(best_ibs_t, colors = pal_ibs_t, opacity = 0.7, group = "IB surge peak time (forecast hr)") |>
  addLayersControl(
    baseGroups = c("Hs0 peak time (forecast hr)", "IB surge peak time (forecast hr)"),
    overlayGroups = c("Observed track", "Forecast track"),
    options = layersControlOptions(collapsed = FALSE)
  ) |>
  hideGroup("IB surge peak time (forecast hr)") |>
  addControl(leg_t_hs0, position = "bottomright") |>
  addControl(leg_t_ibs, position = "bottomright")

m_time <- htmlwidgets::onRender(m_time, "
function(el, x) {
  var map = this;
  function showLegend(name){
    var hs0 = document.getElementById('legend-time-hs0');
    var ibs = document.getElementById('legend-time-ibs');
    if (!hs0 || !ibs) return;
    if (name === 'IB surge peak time (forecast hr)') { hs0.style.display='none'; ibs.style.display='block'; }
    else { hs0.style.display='block'; ibs.style.display='none'; }
  }
  map.on('baselayerchange', function(e){ showLegend(e.name); });
  showLegend('Hs0 peak time (forecast hr)');
}
")
```

## Maps {.tabset}

### Max magnitude

This map shows the **maximum across all storms** at each grid cell, for either:

- **Max Hs0 (m)**, or
- **Max inverse-barometer surge (m)**, computed as **(1010 − Pr)/100**.

```{r map-max}
m_max
```

### Peak timing

This map shows the **forecast hour of the peak** at each grid cell (for the storm that produced the maximum at that cell), for either:

- **Hs0 peak time (forecast hr)**, or
- **IB surge peak time (forecast hr)**.

```{r map-time}
m_time
```
